# TradeWise

> All-in-one AI operating system for tradesmen — from leads and quoting to scheduling, invoicing, and aftercare. Built for trades, not generic SaaS.

TradeWise is a UK-built platform that helps electricians, plumbers, builders, and other trades run their business end-to-end. It combines a CRM, job management, quoting and invoicing, workforce scheduling, a client portal, a material broker, and a marketing suite (website builder, lead reactivation, automations) into one workspace, powered by an AI assistant called TradePal.
